tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page ground in both themes; `foreground` (14:1 light, 18.7:1 dark) and `muted-foreground` read on it. Dark (#08090a) is the product's home theme.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `background`, `muted` and `accent` (≥13:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Raised surface for Card, list panels and the outline Button, and the ground of form controls (Input, Select, Checkbox, Radio, SegmentedControl, RadioCard); separated from `background` by a `border` hairline, not by shade alone.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `card` (14.3:1 light, 17.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Floating layers: Dialog, BottomSheet, Tooltip, Toast, menus. Pair with `shadow-popover`.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `popover` (14.3:1 light, 15.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The single accent (Cryst blue): primary Button fill, active tab underline, checked controls, links, the BottomSheet ✓ confirm icon, the selected SegmentedControl and RadioCard outline. As text it holds ≥4.5:1 on `background`, `card` and its own `selection` tint in both themes.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Label on `primary` fills: white in light (5.7:1), near-black ink in dark (6.4:1).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Quiet fill for the secondary Button and IconButton and the secondary Badge.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `secondary` (9.4:1 light, 12.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Recessed fills: the pill Tabs track, the neutral Badge tint, input groups, kbd keys, table header rows, skeletons.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, hints, placeholders, ghost Button labels, inactive tabs, icons beside labels. Holds ≥4.5:1 on `background`, `card`, `popover`, `muted`, `secondary` and `accent` in both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover and selected-row tint for list rows, ghost Buttons, IconButtons and menu items.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `accent` hover/selected tints (12.6:1 light, 15.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: tab-active
tokens.usage: The selected pill of pill Tabs, raised off its `muted` track. Light is white; dark is lifted above every surface, because `card` sits darker than the dark track (1.03:1) and the selected pill vanished. #3d4047 on the dark track is 1.7:1, and `foreground` on it holds 9.7:1.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Delete actions, error borders and messages, the destructive Badge/Toast. As text ≥4.5:1 on `background`, `card` and its badge tint in both themes.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Label on `destructive` fills: white in light (5.5:1), near-black ink in dark (5.9:1).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success / complete status: circle-check icons, success Badge and Toast. As text ≥4.5:1 on `background`, `card` and its badge tint in both themes. Always pair with an icon or word.

tokens.name: success-foreground
tokens.usage: Label on `success` fills: white in light (5.3:1), near-black ink in dark (8:1).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Pending / at-risk status: alert-triangle icons, warning Badge and Toast. As text ≥4.5:1 on `background`, `card` and its badge tint in both themes. Always pair with an icon or word.

tokens.name: warning-foreground
tokens.usage: Label on `warning` fills: white in light (5.2:1), near-black ink in dark (9:1).

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational status and neutral notices: info-circle icons, info Badge and Toast. As text ≥4.5:1 on `background`, `card` and its badge tint in both themes.

tokens.name: info-foreground
tokens.usage: Label on `info` fills: white in light (5.3:1), near-black ink in dark (7.8:1).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: The 1px structural hairline between surfaces, rows and panels (decorative, 1.2–1.4:1 by design; never the only cue on a control).

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Borders of Input, Select, Checkbox, Radio and secondary Button, and the Switch off-track. A quiet hairline one step stronger than `border` (1.2–1.5:1 by choice): a field reads by its label and `card` fill, and focus turns its border to `ring`.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring: a 2px ring offset by 2px of `background` on buttons, and the focused field border (≥5.5:1 light, ≥6.3:1 dark on every surface).

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Text selection, the `primary` Badge tint, the selected SegmentedControl and RadioCard fill and the soft 3px halo around focused fields (the `ring` border carries the focus contrast).

color.note: shadcn/ui variable names, including the chart-* and sidebar-* sets (aliases of the core colors). Light is listed first for the page; the product is dark-first. Set data-theme="dark" on <html>, or add the shadcn-style class="dark" (the bundle stylesheet mirrors the dark values for it).

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase overline labels (`text-xs`, `tracking-caps`); set text-transform: uppercase.

styles.name: ui-text
styles.usage: The desktop UI default: controls, list rows, settings copy (`text-sm`).
styles.sample: Review your settings and save when you're ready.

styles.name: ui-label
styles.usage: Button and tab labels, emphasized row titles (`weight-medium`).

styles.name: reading
styles.sample: Long-form content steps up to 15px with relaxed leading.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: IDs, shortcuts, timestamps, amounts in tables, code (`text-sm` in JetBrains Mono).

styles.name: code-small
styles.usage: kbd keys and inline code in meta rows (`text-xs`).

styles.name: m-body
styles.usage: Mobile body and xl control text (`m-text-body`, `m-leading-body`).

styles.name: m-footnote
styles.usage: Mobile footnotes, captions and meta in `muted-foreground` (`m-text-footnote`).

type.note: Two faces, and no third. Sans is Noto Sans JP at 400–700 — the whole interface, Japanese and Latin alike; mono is JetBrains Mono at 400–700 for IDs, shortcuts, timestamps, figures in tables and code. Both variable fonts are stored with the system and declared by src/cryst/fonts.css. Noto Sans JP includes Latin, kana and all 2,965 JIS X 0208 level-1 kanji; text outside the subset falls back to the platform fonts. No font requires a network connection. The Tabler icon font is not a text face: it is only ever used through the `.ti` classes.

spacing.note: Three groups share this family: the 4px scale (`space-*`), desktop control heights (`control-*`), and layout constants — `sidebar-width`, `content-max`, and the mobile set (`m-*`, all 44px targets). Use `m-control` rather than `tap-target`, which is only the reference value.

radius.note: `radius` is shadcn's base (= `radius-lg`); the scale runs `radius-sm` inner controls → `radius-md` controls → `radius-lg` cards → `radius-xl` dialogs and sheets → `radius-full` pills.

shadow.note: Elevation is reserved for floating layers. A Card or an Alert sits on the page with a hairline and `shadow-sm` at most; anything that floats over content (menus, toasts, dialogs) carries `shadow-md` or more.

motion.note: Three durations and two curves. Everything in the system uses `ease-out`; `ease-in-out` is for a movement that starts and ends on screen.
